correctness.rationale: Exact graph predicates give 260 disconnected 4-sets and 6994 faces by two algorithms. Explicit 3484-pair matching passes a complete 42393-edge Hasse DAG check, leaving one critical 0-cell and 25 critical 6-cells; Forman theory yields the integral wedge. Independent mod-two ranks confirm. Signed Lefschetz traces for all 78 verified affine graph automorphisms are 25/-1/1, hence the rational character and 1-dimensional invariant quotient homology.

value.rationale: The Paley-thirteen graph is a natural uniquely specified highly symmetric strongly regular object. Its ordinary four-cut complex is nontrivial while its total four-cut complex is void, is pure dimension 8 yet has integral homotopy concentrated in dimension 6, and carries a succinct nontrivial affine representation 1+2 Aug with a rational homology consequence for the quotient. These give structural topological and equivariant information beyond the numerical face vector and cannot be inferred from the general high-skeleton theorem; a new family theorem is not needed.
